invariants.rationale: MapProperties is used for storing the loaded property and should always be non-null when calling this method.
Name is used as the key to store the object; it should be non-null and non-empty to be meaningful.
The value is parsed with Integer.parseInt(value), so it cannot be null without throwing an exception (and thus, the method would not reach exit).
If the method reaches exit, value must be syntactically a valid integer string (or else Integer.parseInt would throw).
